items.text: Bid compliance and delivery: assemble the proposal as a single PDF of at most 20 pages and submit it through the College's procurement portal by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC, and ensure the service is live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment.
items.basis: The portal submission deadline, file format, and page limit are explicitly stated, as is the mandatory go-live date for spring enrollment.

items.text: Signing platform: support signing on current desktop and mobile browsers, and send a reminder to each signer who has not signed within 72 hours.
items.basis: The browser environments and the 72-hour reminder window are specified in the requirements.

items.text: Audit and records: maintain an audit record of every signature event including signer identity, time, and document version, and store signed documents for ten years.
items.basis: The required audit details and the ten-year retention period are defined.

items.text: System integration: integrate the service with the College's student records system through its existing REST API.
items.basis: The integration target and method via existing REST API are defined.

items.text: Operations and availability: ensure the service is available 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance.
items.basis: The availability percentage, calculation period, and planned maintenance notification lead time are stated.

questions.text: Which specific documents comprise the College's twelve most used forms for template provision?
What is the data structure and volume of the signed records in the current tool to be migrated by 2027-02-28?
Should the optional on-premises deployment be priced separately, and what infrastructure constraints apply?
What support ticketing system or communication channel should be used for responding to severity-one incidents within one hour?
